comment: swo_capture.py --setup entries: writes are applied (journalled, restored), behind access port `ap` when given and only with the capture feature `for` names when given; `bits` sizes a narrower register, `key` is ORed into its writes, `requires` names an earlier write a restore needs in place, `gates_trace_unit` marks the write that makes a `jlink_device` part's TPIU reachable; watch entries must read (value & mask) == value and are never written, only snapshotted before and after. Evidence in swo-boards.md

writes.name: DBGMCU_CR
writes.why: TRACE_IOEN=1, TRACE_MODE=00 asynchronous: TRACECLKIN is tied low until set

watch.name: GPIOB_MODER
watch.why: PB3 (JTDO/TRACESWO) in alternate function mode, its reset state; firmware may have remapped it
watch.ref: RM0090 (book 3636) GPIOx_MODER reset values, p283; TRACESWO on JTDO, p1671

stm32h7.traceclk: undocumented: 400 MHz worked on stm32h743nucleo, where rcc_c_ck and pll1_r_ck are both 400 MHz

writes.name: TSG_CNTCR
writes.why: EN: the global timestamp counter runs (reset 0); only for --global-ts
writes.ref: RM0433 (book 4918) TSG_CNTCR, p3109; the TSG at 0xE00E5000 behind AP2, p3101

watch.name: DBGMCU_CR
watch.why: TRACECLKEN, D1DBGCKEN, D3DBGCKEN; stm32h7x.cfg examine-end sets them

watch.name: SWTF_CTRL
watch.why: ENS0 passes the core's trace to the SWO unit; stm32h7x.cfg examine-end sets ENS0|ENS1

watch.name: GPIOB_MODER
watch.why: PB3 (JTDO/TRACESWO) in alternate function mode, its reset state; firmware may have remapped it

stm32h7.jlink: unsupported: the SWO unit is not the core TPIU this J-Link route programs

ra6m5.traceclk: the system clock source divided by TRCKCR.TRCK (/2 after reset, kept as found): 100 MHz from TinyUSB's 200 MHz PLL

writes.name: PRCR
writes.why: PRC0 unlocks TRCKCR; a write takes effect only with PRKEY 0xA5, which reads 0

writes.name: TRCKCR
writes.why: TRCKEN starts the trace clock (reset 0); a TPIU read with it stopped left ra6m5_ek's AHB-AP wedged until power-off (cause suspected; swo-boards.md), so no TPIU access comes before it
writes.ref: RA6M5 HW manual (book 5584) TRCKCR, p191; TRCLK, Table 8.2 p152; TPIU note 1, p86

watch.name: P109PFS
watch.why: P109 as TDO/SWO (PMR 1, PSEL 0), its reset state; firmware may have remapped it, as TXD9 say
watch.ref: RA6M5 HW manual (book 5584) PmnPFS and its note 1, p529-530; P109 after reset, p523

ra6m5.openocd: unsupported: not tried, and the OpenOCD route does not hold back TPIU access while the trace clock is stopped
